message.reasoning_content: We need to determine crimes. Facts: Wang 1 (王1某) provided false guarantee, assisted companies to obtain loans fraudulently. That's "骗取贷款罪" which is a type of fraud (loan fraud). Also "窝藏罪" for assisting Guo? Actually the second part mentions Guo (郭某) but the prosecution says Wang also provided hiding? Let's read: The indictment says: "第二、窝藏罪 ... 2016年12月12日，林郭某安局对郭1某涉嫌骗取贷款罪一案立案进行侦查。同年12月份，被告郭某栋明知郭1某涉嫌犯罪的情况下，仍负责给其开车，郭某辆帮助郭1某先后潜逃至... 途郭某金栋用郭1某提供的他人身份证办理登郭某，帮助郭1某到银行提取现金、联系租房居住、购买生活用品等。" This describes Guo (郭某栋) as the one who helped. But the indictment says "王1某以欺骗手段取得银行贷款...且明知是犯罪的人而为其提供隐藏的处所、财物，帮助其逃匿". So they allege Wang also helped hide. So crimes: 1) 诈骗 (骗取贷款) 2) 窝藏 (concealing). According to correction rules: When listing crime name(s) between [罪名] and <eoa>, output only statutory offense name without appending the character “罪”. So we should list "骗取贷款" and "窝藏". Also if multiple distinct fraud categories, list each separately; here only loan fraud. So final answer: [罪名]骗取贷款;窝藏<eoa>. JSON format with reasoning and final_answer.
